bio: Tuck into a delightful Afternoon Tea at Peckforton Castle in Cheshire.  Nestled in acres of beautiful Cheshire countryside, Peckforton Castle is an enchanting hotel that has plenty of elegant charm. Savour every bite of a mouth-watering Afternoon Tea for two in this stunning location. Tuck into an assortment of delicious finger sandwiches, a variety of French pastries and fluffy scones layered perfectly with jam and cream.  This utterly indulgent treat is perfect for those keen to celebrate a special occasion in style. Delight in a scrumptious selection of sweet and savoury delights and catch up with a friend over this timeless British tradition.
